entry.name: in
entry.digest: Message input for a patcher loaded by poly~ or pfft~
entry.description: in defines a message inlet for a patcher loaded by poly~ or pfft~.

arguments.name: inlet-number/positioning
arguments.description: Obligatory. Each in object is identified by a unique index number which specifies which message inlet in aorobject it corresponds to. The first outlet is 1.
